partition_contract.implementation: 旧implementation_source/test_sourceは候補source存在の静的記録。unit実装成立・旧実行は示さない

evidence_partition.candidate: representative_legacy_assets and catalog status; search candidates only
evidence_partition.old_implementation: implementation_source/test_source review edges; static, unexecuted, unit status unknown
evidence_partition.old_failure: coverage.failure and ledger failure fields; observed receipt only, status unknown
evidence_partition.old_degradation: phase transition and constraint assessment only; unit status unknown
evidence_partition.old_consumer: observed refs and ledger/decision/read-after refs; closure pending
evidence_partition.current_implementation: current context refs only; direct implementation evidence absent, status unknown
evidence_partition.current_acceptance: direct acceptance receipt only; none found, status unknown

証拠欠落やunknownから未実装を断定しない
degradation/failureの静的partitionから実行failureを導かない
consumer refs、decision、read-afterからconsumer closureを導かない
